rules.name: Mandatory EoA Document Bundle Completeness
rules.description: Extension of Approval applications must include Affidavit-1, Building Safety/Fire NOC, and Affiliating University NOC.
rules.sourceReference: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2026-27, Chapter II, Clause 2.1

rules.name: Fire & Life Safety Certificate Validity Period
rules.description: Fire Safety Certificate must be valid throughout the academic session (must not expire prior to June 30, 2026).

rules.name: AICTE Permanent Institute ID (PID) Cross-Consistency
rules.description: Permanent Institute ID (PID) on all supporting affidavits, land records, and previous approval orders must match the application identifier exactly.

rules.name: Legal Institution Name Exact & Normalized Alignment
rules.description: Institution Name stated across Land documents, Affiliation Letters, and Society Undertaking must match within acceptable phonetical/abbreviation tolerances.

rules.name: Land Ownership / Registered Lease Agreement Validity
rules.description: For leased campuses, the registered lease deed must have a remaining term of at least 30 years (or minimum 10 years for mega-cities).
rules.sourceReference: AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2026-27, Chapter I, Norms for Land

rules.name: Faculty to Student Ratio Compliance for Approved Intake
rules.description: Engineering & Technology institutions requesting intake increment must maintain Cadre Ratio 1:2:6 and FSR of at least 1:20.

rules.name: Barrier-Free Campus Infrastructure for Persons with Disabilities
rules.description: Campuses must submit verifiable photographic and architectural evidence of ramps, accessible elevators, and dedicated washrooms.
rules.sourceReference: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act & AICTE Guidelines
